step_zero.title: Welcome to your workspace
step_zero.description: To help you get started, we’ve created a Demo Container for you. Let’s add your first task.

step_one.title: Click “+ Add task”
step_one.description: Start by clicking the “+ New Task” button. You can create tasks, bugs, or custom type that fits your needs.

step_two.title: Filter your tasks
step_two.description: Use filters to quickly narrow down your list. You can filter by status, priority, or team members.

step_three.title: View, group, and order tasks as needed.
step_three.description: See required properties, and group or order tasks as per your needs.

step_four.title: Visualize however you want
step_four.description: Select which properties you want to see in the list. You can also group and sort tasks your way.

step_zero.title: Make progress with Cycles
step_zero.description: Press Q to create a Cycle. Name it and set dates—only one cycle per container.

step_one.title: Create a new cycle
step_one.description: Press Q to create a Cycle. Name it and set dates—only one cycle per container.

step_two.title: Click “+ ”
step_two.description: Start by clicking the “+” button. Add new or existing tasks directly from the Cycle page.

step_three.title: Cycle summary
step_three.description: Track cycle progress, team productivity, and priorities—and investigate if things fall behind.

step_four.title: Transfer tasks
step_four.description: After the due date, a cycle auto-completes. Move unfinished work to another cycle.

step_zero.title: Break your container down into Projects / Jobs
step_zero.description: Projects / Jobs are smaller, focused units of work that help users group and organize tasks within specific time frames.

step_one.title: Create Project / Job
step_one.description: Projects / Jobs are smaller, focused units of work that help users group and organize tasks within specific time frames.

step_two.title: Click “+ ”
step_two.description: Start by clicking the “+” button. Add new or existing tasks directly from the Project / Job page.

step_three.title: Project / Job states
step_three.description: Projects / Jobs use these statuses to help users plan and clearly track progress and stage.

step_four.title: Project / Job progress
step_four.description: Project / Job progress is tracked via completed items, with analytics to monitor performance.

step_zero.title: Document with AI-powered Pages
step_zero.description: Pages in Geotech3D let you capture, organize, and collaborate on container info—no external tools needed.

step_one.title: Make page Public or Private
step_one.description: Pages can be set as public, visible to everyone in your workspace, or private, accessible only to you.

step_two.title: Use / command
step_two.description: Use / on a page to add content from 16 block types, including lists, images, tables, and embeds.

step_three.title: Page actions
step_three.description: Once your page is created, you can click the ••• menu in the top-right corner to perform the following actions.

step_four.title: Table of contents
step_four.description: Get a bird’s-eye view of your page by clicking the panel icon to see all headings.

step_five.title: Version history
step_five.description: Pages track all edits with version history, letting you restore previous versions if needed.

step_zero.title: Streamline your requests
step_zero.description: A Geotech3D-only feature that lets Guests create tasks for bugs, requests, or tickets.

step_one.title: Open/closed requests
step_one.description: Pending requests stay in the Open tab, and once addressed by an admin or member, they move to Closed.

step_two.title: Accept/decline a pending request
step_two.description: Accept to edit and move the task to your container, or decline it to mark it as Cancelled.

step_three.title: Snooze for now
step_three.description: A task can be snoozed to review it at a later time. It will be moved to the bottom of your open request list.

step_zero.title: Stop tab-switching. Connect your world.
step_zero.description: Link GitHub, Slack to track PRs and summarize chats directly in Geotech3D AI.

step_one.description: Your inbox keeps all mentions, approvals, and activity in one place, so you never miss important work.

step_two.title: Personalize Your Navigation
step_two.description: Customize what you see and how you navigate in Preferences.
